## Orientation

Inline execution in `/home/andrewyin/orchestra/.worktrees/installer-wizard`, wave 3. Detection and the prompt primitives already landed. This task wires the model, CLI, and runner together and adds the subprocess tests. Code writes stay in the worktree; the primary checkout remains the store writer.

### Work-item (quote)

## Description

R1: Running `orchestra install` with no host flags on an interactive TTY launches the host-selection wizard instead of selecting every provider.
R8: The wizard prints the full plan and asks for confirmation before writing.
R9: Declining confirmation exits without writing a host payload.
R10: `--list` prints the provider matrix with project and global detection and exits without writing.
R11: `--scope {project,global}` selects the install scope and conflicts with `--global`.
R12: `--interactive` forces the wizard when standard input is not a TTY.
R13: `--non-interactive` or `--yes` suppresses prompts; host selection uses `--only` or `--all` when given, otherwise detected hosts.
R14: With no host flags and no TTY, or with `--yes`, the installer selects detected hosts; if none are detected it exits 2 with guidance and writes nothing.
R15: Explicit `--only` and `--all` select exactly those providers and skip the host prompt.
R16: `--dry-run` with the wizard prints the plan and writes nothing without asking for confirmation.
R17: `--uninstall` remains flag-driven and never launches the wizard.

## Approach

Extend `InstallRequest` with `scope`, `list_only`, `interactive`, and `non_interactive`. Add `--list`, `--scope {project,global}`, `--interactive`, and `--non-interactive`/`--yes` to `orchestra/cli.py`; keep `--global` as an alias and reject `--scope` with `--global`. Map the arguments in `orchestra/install.py`.

In `installer/runner.py`, compute detection once with `installer/detect.py`. Short-circuit `--list` to print the matrix and write nothing. Determine `wants_wizard` from the TTY, `--interactive`, and explicit host flags. With no host flags and no TTY or `--yes`, use detected hosts, and exit 2 with guidance when none are detected. When the wizard runs, use `installer/wizard.py` to prompt hosts, scope, and mode. Build the plan, print it, and ask for confirmation before `apply`; `--dry-run` prints the plan and returns without confirmation. Preserve `--only` request order, `--all`, idempotency, and flag-driven uninstall.

Add focused subprocess tests in `tests/test_installer_wizard.py` for the TTY decision, plan and confirmation, decline, `--list`, scope, interactive, non-interactive, empty detection, explicit flags, dry-run, and uninstall. Add one real-entry-point integration test in `tests/integration/test_installer_wizard.py` that pipes wizard input through the real `bin/orchestra install` entry point and installs only the selected host.

### Requirements (quote by id)

R1: Running `orchestra install` with no host flags on an interactive TTY launches the host-selection wizard instead of selecting every provider.
R8: The wizard prints the full plan and asks for confirmation before writing.
R9: Declining confirmation exits without writing a host payload.
R10: `--list` prints the provider matrix with project and global detection and exits without writing.
R11: `--scope {project,global}` selects the install scope and conflicts with `--global`.
R12: `--interactive` forces the wizard when standard input is not a TTY.
R13: `--non-interactive` or `--yes` suppresses prompts; host selection uses `--only` or `--all` when given, otherwise detected hosts.
R14: With no host flags and no TTY, or with `--yes`, the installer selects detected hosts; if none are detected it exits 2 with guidance and writes nothing.
R15: Explicit `--only` and `--all` select exactly those providers and skip the host prompt.
R16: `--dry-run` with the wizard prints the plan and writes nothing without asking for confirmation.
R17: `--uninstall` remains flag-driven and never launches the wizard.

### Design / decisions (quote)

Invariants:
- Detection, `--list`, `--dry-run`, and a declined confirmation write nothing.
- Planning happens before any apply; a declined plan leaves the tree untouched.
- The selected scope and mode are visible in the rendered plan.
- `--only` preserves request order and `--only` plus `--all` remains an error.
- A second install with the same inputs is idempotent.
- `--uninstall` removes only entries named by a registration.
- `--home` redirects both detection bases and prevents reads of the real HOME.
- Existing host adapters and payload layouts are unchanged.

Assumptions:
- `sys.stdin.isatty()` and `sys.stdout.isatty()` are the interactivity signal.
- `--interactive` is available for tests and demos without a PTY.
- The project base is the cwd, the global base is HOME, and `--home` replaces both.
- A host is detected when its marker exists or any provider `detect` path exists at the base.
- A prompt EOF or Ctrl-C is a cancel, not an install error.
- The provider matrix's `detect` paths remain relative to the install base.

Decisions:
- `installer-wizard-approach`: `stdlib-wizard-detection` (alternatives: `textual-tui-detection`, `detection-flags-only`).
- `installer-default-detected`: `detected-require-choice` (alternatives: `detected-native-fallback`, `all-providers`).
- `installer-detection-both-scopes`: `project-and-global` (alternatives: `selected-scope-only`).
- `installer-wizard-install-only`: `install-only` (alternatives: `wizard-install-and-uninstall`).
